messages.subject: Project Redwood — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We completed the acquisition of Redwood House at 1.50pm today. Calderfield Redwood Propco Limited is now the freehold owner. Tenants are being notified to pay future rents to the SPV.

Next steps on our side: submit the SDLT return and pay £1,077,000 within 14 days; lodge the Land Registry application (AP1, fee £1,105). The £100,000 review retention is held on our client account pending the Mercer Wells review.

Thank you all — a pleasure.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 134777 Bishopsgate | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
